findings.issue: National label prospects and wording for slots 7-8. Under §8a the only label within reach is 'First-in-class' ('State of the art' does not apply), and it needs Secchi AND (turbidity OR TSS) against every applicable baseline with CIs excluding 0 plus the seed rule. On validation the best student is behind GBM + context on Secchi (+1.5 [-1.6, +5.0]) and no CI excludes 0 on any target; under Q1b ANCHOR-Lite must also beat its own anchor S6. Two wording risks remain: H1 and H-G6 compare only against band ratios and GBM-RGBN, so a candidate with a tabular anchor can pass them through location and season alone; and the novelty file covers NAIP lake models only, not a GBM-anchored hybrid and not P2.

summary: The file changed during review: the given hash was on disk until about 18:13 UTC; it is now v0.3 (2b369018…), which I reviewed.
